baseline: Exact bytes with listed input substitutions only; owner/profile names and all route/security settings retained.

variants.restart-route: Insert POST /containers/*/restart allow before the final profile deny. Inspector evidence only, never exact baseline behavior.
variants.strict-root: Set exec.allow_root_user=false. Baseline deliberately permits root for PatchSystemEnv.
variants.restart-route-volume: Insert POST /containers/*/restart allow before the final profile deny. Inspector evidence only, never exact baseline behavior.
variants.baseline-observe: CLI --log-level debug only; no security/routing changes, diagnostic evidence separate from baseline.
